purpose: Hash-pinned inventory of every input this repository reads. A pin is an integrity statement about the bytes on this machine, not an authentication of organizer provenance.
retrieval_route: api.github.com Git blobs API (host in the sandbox allowlist) from buffedlizard55-lab/GEMSDOE@main commit dcbbb19-adjacent tree fetched 2026-10-09; the GEMSDOE repo mirrors the DrivenData data tab via data/bridge shards, assembled by scripts/assemble_data_bridge.py
why_not_direct: The DrivenData data tab is login-gated and the sandbox egress allowlist is github.com, codeload.github.com, api.github.com, registry.npmjs.org, pypi.org, files.pythonhosted.org. Neither drivendata.org nor dropbox.com norprd-tnm.s3.amazonaws.com is reachable from this sandbox, so the rasters are carried in through the owner's hash-pinned mirror.

catalogue.role: the competition fault catalogue (USGS quaternary faults + INGENIOUS), rasterised on the 100 m grid; 60,988 positive cells; int8; nodata -1. THIS is the object the corrections lane measures.
catalogue.provenance: owner mirror of https://www.drivendata.org/competitions/306/competition-doe-gems/data/ existing_faults.tif; committed in this repo, verified at build time by scripts/prepare_data.py
catalogue.not_authenticated_by: no organizer signature; no DrivenData account in this sandbox

sample.role: the organizer's sample submission, used by the format gate as the CRS/shape/transform reference
sample.provenance: owner mirror of example_submission.tif from the same data tab (dropbox mirror URL recorded in GEMSDOE data/bridge/manifest.json)
sample.measured_surprise: documented on the problem page as 'a sample submission that predicts total fault absence', but cell-for-cell equal to the catalogue mask; see evidence/grid.json sample_submission_forensics and IR-56-001

features.role: official 19-band GeoDAWN numerical feature stack, 100 m, EPSG:32611
features.rebuild: concatenate data/bridge/gems-geodawn-numerical-features.tif.part-000..004 from buffedlizard55-lab/GEMSDOE@main (five blobs, each pinned in that repo's data/bridge/manifest.json) and verify the assembled sha256 above; scripts/fetch_inputs.sh does this end to end
features.provenance: assembled from shards on 2026-10-09T04:24Z; every shard hash matched the owner manifest before assembly
features.not_authenticated_by: the manifest is owner-maintained; the original download was not witnessed by this session

lidar_scarp.role: LiDAR calibration layer: int16, 7 bands, value/SCALE encodings (h_all m, strike_at deg, facing_at, cover fraction), built by GEMSDOE48 from 700 USGS 3DEP 1 m tiles (NV WestCentral EarthMRI 2020) resampled to 3 m and aggregated to the competition grid
lidar_scarp.provenance: buffedlizard55-lab/GEMSDOE48@main data/external/h52_scarp3m_100m.tif, fetched through api.github.com blobs on 2026-10-09T04:27Z
lidar_scarp.caveat: a sibling lane's derived product, not an organizer file. Its merge receipt (h52_scarp3m_100m.json: 697 npz shards, 700 tiles ok, 5,900,588 cells with cover, workflow run 37565284104) is owner-recorded and was not re-run here. Used only to calibrate the 100 m crest estimator, never as a scoring target.
